prof.sailor.desc.E03: Merchant ships sail all over the Mediterranean. Dangerous, but it pays.
prof.soldier.desc.E03: Service in the army: hoplite, rower or mercenary.
prof.scribe.desc.E03: Few people can write, so scribes are valued.
prof.physician.desc.E03: Healing by the books of Greek doctors. Respected and well paid.
prof.priest.desc.E03: Serving the gods at a temple.
focus.learn.desc.E03: Reading and counting with a schoolmaster. The family pays
focus.health.desc.E03: Baths, the gymnasium, rest and herbs
lifestyle.food.varied.desc.E03: Fish, fruit, wine. Good for health
lifestyle.exercise.gymnasium.desc.E03: Wrestling, running, exercise. Stronger and healthier
lifestyle.medicine.temple.desc.E03: Asclepius, Isis: prayers and sleeping in the temple
ev.a_good_harvest.text.1.E03: The barley stood like a wall, the ears heavy and rustling. For the first time in years the granary can't hold the harvest, and you sleep soundly.
ev.a_good_harvest.text.2.E03: A generous year: the olive trees bend under their fruit, and the press creaks until late at night. The whole house smells of fresh oil.
ev.a_money_quarrel.text.E03: {npc} counted the coins in the jar and asked where half of them had gone. You had to confess to the new sandals - and then hear about the sandals until midnight.
ev.a_stolen_tunic.text.E03: While you were warming up at the baths, someone walked off with your best tunic. You had to go home in a stranger's threadbare cloak, wishing the thief every misfortune you could name.
ev.a_eclipse.text.E03: In broad daylight the sun went dark, as if someone had cupped a hand over it. Dogs howled, priests cried out, then the light came back - and everyone pretended they hadn't been frightened at all.
ev.a_letter_relative.text.E03: {npc} sent a letter from a distant city: alive, well, asking for a warm cloak and telling you not to believe the rumors. Which rumors, the letter doesn't say.
ev.a_scribe_blot.text.E03: You knocked the inkpot over an almost finished scroll. Three days of work spread into a blot shaped like a sea monster. You were copying it again until dawn.
ev.a_merchant_route.text.E03: A mule driver showed you a mountain path your competitors haven't heard of yet. It's four days shorter - and a whole cartload of fodder cheaper.
ev.a_goat_vineyard.text.E03: Your goat squeezed into the neighbor's vineyard and ate everything it could reach. The neighbor wants compensation, the goat is satisfied, and you are not.
ev.a_harbor_wages.text.E03: Three ships came into harbor at once, and there weren't enough hands. You hauled cargo until dark, and the foreman paid double without haggling.
ev.a_kitchen_figs.text.E03: The old cook slipped you a handful of dried figs and winked. A small thing - but in this house even small things don't belong to you, and so you remember it for a long time.
ev.a_temple_omen.text.E03: You checked three times that the altar fire burned evenly and the knife was clean. The omens came out favorable, and the crowd at the temple let out its breath together with you.
ev.a_child_puppy.text.E03: {npc} dragged home a stray puppy and swears it will guard the house. So far it is diligently guarding only your sandal - and has already chewed through half of it.
ev.a_friend_tavern.text.E03: {npc} dragged you into a tavern for "just one cup." It came to five, and the argument over whose neighborhood is better was never settled - even though you live on the same street.
ev.a_neighbor_noise.text.2.E03: The neighbor's donkey brays at dawn loud enough to wake the whole street. Its owner insists the donkey is simply very pious and greets the sun.
ev.a_partner_cheat.text.E03: For two years your partner has been doctoring the shared accounts. Under a floorboard you found the second, real tablet of records - and you didn't like the sum on it at all.
ev.a_rival_revenge.make_peace.E03: Come to make peace with a jug of wine
ev.a_moneylender.text.E03: The money ran out before the winter did. The moneylender by the temple will give you as much as you ask - at interest that turns the neighbors' beards gray at the mere mention.
ev.a_moneylender_returns.text.E03: The old moneylender is dead, but his son remembers every coin. He arrives with a tablet in hand: over the years your debt has nearly doubled.
ev.a_foundling.text.E03: At dawn someone left a baby in a basket at the temple gate. This is how the poor give up children they cannot feed: whoever picks the child up will raise it.
ev.a_foundling.find_family.success.E03: The potter's wife, who had prayed to the gods for a child for years, wept with joy as she took the basket.
ev.a_foundling.find_family.failure.E03: No one wanted another mouth to feed. You left the baby with the temple attendants and couldn't sleep for a long time.
ev.a_foundling_grown.text.E03: The child you once picked up at the temple gate has grown up. The neighbors whisper behind your back, and the questions you have avoided for so long are about to be asked out loud.
ev.a_affair_letter.text.E03: A former servant of that very house brings a bundle of your old notes on wax tablets and hints that they are worth money. Otherwise, the wrong people may read them.
ev.a_affair_letter.refuse.success.E03: He grumbled and left. The tablets seem to have vanished somewhere in his junk.
ev.a_lawsuit.self.success.E03: You asked how a donkey had climbed a fence as tall as a man. Even the judges laughed.
ev.a_inheritance.text.E03: The inheritance isn't divided yet, and {npc} already claims the whole olive grove: "I looked after the old man while you were off who knows where." And {g=npc_sex:he|she} is not entirely wrong.
ev.a_inheritance.court.success.E03: The court awarded you more than half. You won the grove and lost your family.
ev.a_sibling_reconcile.text.E03: {npc} never forgot how you once gave up Father's grove. In a lean year {g=npc_sex:he|she} came to you unasked, with a cart full of oil and grain.
ev.a_hide_friend.text.E03: At night {npc} knocks at your door. The magistrate's men are in pursuit: the charge is theft from the treasury. {g=npc_sex:He|She} swears to be innocent and begs you to hide {g=npc_sex:him|her} until morning.
ev.a_peculium.text.E03: An old servant of your household has been saving coppers for twenty years. Today he silently poured them onto the table - exactly what was once paid for him.
ev.a_freedman_returns.text.E03: Your former servant now keeps a shop by the city gate, and business is booming. As custom requires, he comes to pay his respects with a basket of the finest dates - and sends profitable buyers your way.
ev.a_boundary.talk.E03: Invite the neighbor over for a jug of wine
ev.a_boundary.talk.failure.E03: The wine was drunk, and the stone stayed right where it was. A waste of good snacks, too.
ev.a_neighbor_helps.text.E03: When a storm flattened your barley, the very neighbor you once made peace with over the boundary stone was the first to arrive with his sons and their sickles. Together you brought in the field before the next rain.
ev.a_house_fever.pray.failure.E03: The gods were silent. The illness wore you down to the bone.
ev.a_bakery.text.E03: The baker on your street is getting old and is looking for a partner: millstones, an oven, two donkeys and a queue around the corner every morning. He wants the money up front.
ev.a_poor_debtor.text.E03: The carter who has owed you for a whole year came empty-handed. You have every right to take his mules - but without the mules his family will be begging.
ev.a_poor_debtor.defer.success.E03: Two years later the carter brought everything down to the last coin - and a little extra "for your patience."
ev.a_poor_debtor.defer.failure.E03: The extra time passed and there's still no money. Now the carter crosses to the other side of the street.
ev.a_debtor_saves.text.E03: On a deserted road robbers surrounded you - and then a cart came thundering around the bend: the carter whose debt you once forgave, with his three sons wielding clubs. The robbers scattered.
ev.j_farm_measure.expose.failure.E03: The cheat swore by every god that the measure was honest and found witnesses. The grain went cheap, and you made an enemy.
ev.j_farm_new_way.text.E03: A neighbour who served in distant lands says that there they sow beans or vetch on the resting field, and a year later the wheat stands like a wall. The village elders laugh: "The soil doesn't like inventions."
ev.j_lab_crane.text.E03: At the temple building site they're raising columns with a great treadwheel crane, with men walking inside the wheel. The foreman wants someone to climb the scaffolding and guide the stone into place. Double pay.
ev.j_weave_pattern.text.E03: You came up with a border like no one else's: a wave turning into a vine. Less than a month later, the woman across the street was selling the same one.
ev.j_mid_blame.temple.E03: Go to the temple for a purification rite
ev.j_mid_book.text.E03: A learned Greek physician is writing a book on women's ailments and childbirth. He asks to accompany you on your calls and write down everything you do.
ev.j_merch_inspector.bribe.success.E03: The coin vanished into his sleeve, and the inspector moved on as if he'd noticed nothing.
ev.j_merch_inspector.retest.E03: Demand a reweighing on the standard scales at the temple
ev.j_merch_hoard.text.E03: The harvest failed, the grain ships are late, and prices rise every day. Your storehouse is full. Hold the goods back another month and you can sell at three times the price.
ev.j_merch_branch_later.text.E03: The Alexandrian business has grown: you have a warehouse by the Great Harbour and clerks who speak three languages. Ships from all over the sea know your name.
ev.j_sail_late.text.E03: It's already November, and by custom the sea is closed until spring. But the captain is in a hurry: the cargo is valuable, the pay is double. He needs men who aren't afraid of winter storms.
ev.j_sail_late.persuade.success.E03: The captain grumbled but stayed. A week later another ship was wrecked on the cape, and the captain poured you wine in front of everyone.
ev.j_sol_recruiter.text.E03: A recruiter has appeared in the harbour: a king across the sea needs Greek mercenaries and pays in gold. They say men who come back from such campaigns buy themselves houses.
ev.j_sol_recruiter.haggle.failure.E03: The lads laughed at you, and the recruiter sailed off without them.
ev.j_sol_return_rich.text.E03: You've come back from the distant campaign, older, scarred, and with a belt heavy with foreign coins. At home they barely recognized you.
ev.j_sol_grain.report.success.E03: The strategos sent an inspection. The commander was removed, the rations restored, and you were commended.
ev.j_scr_papyrus.text.E03: Papyrus has gone up in price again. A trader you know whispers that he can get cheap rolls, no questions asked about where they came from.
ev.j_scr_papyrus.smuggled.success.E03: The rolls were excellent, and the trader discreet.
ev.j_scr_papyrus.palimpsest.E03: Wash old rolls and write on them again
ev.j_scr_records_audit.text.E03: An inspector is going through years of old scrolls. Your old misstep, a record altered for money, is lying on his desk.
ev.j_phys_treatise_later.text.E03: Your treatise is being copied in Alexandria and Pergamon. One day a young man from a distant island appeared at your door: he read the book and wants to study with no one but you.
ev.j_pri_omen.text.E03: Before an important undertaking of the city, you perform a sacrifice. The signs are bad, as bad as they come. And the man who ordered the rite is watching you, waiting for only one answer.
ev.j_pri_omen.repeat.E03: Suggest repeating the rite until the gods relent
ev.j_pri_treasury.text.E03: You've noticed offerings disappearing from the temple treasury: silver cups, coins from the offering box. Only the treasurer has the keys.
ev.j_land_vines.text.E03: Wine fetches a good price: merchants buy it by the amphora for distant lands. You could turn your wheat fields over to vines, but the first real harvest is years away.
ev.j_land_vines_harvest.text.E03: The vines have finally come into their strength. Amphorae bearing your stamp are loaded onto ships, and merchants bid for every one.
ev.j_mag_games_echo.text.E03: Years later people still recall your festival. Whole districts vote for you, and your new office brings not only honour but income.
ev.j_mag_creditors.text.E03: The moneylenders who financed that festival will wait no longer. Their men sit in your house with tablets, and the interest has grown so large it's frightening to count.
ev.j_mag_election.text.E03: The election for high office is coming. Your rival is already handing out money and feasting the voters. Your friends say you can't win without money.
ev.j_mag_election.honest.failure.E03: They listened to your speeches gladly and voted for the man who fed them.
ev.j_mag_ambitus_trial.text.E03: Old rivals have dug up how you bought votes in that election. You're charged with electoral bribery, and the penalty could be exile.
ev.j_hs_secret.text.E03: While serving wine, you heard what your master discussed with a guest: a deal no one was supposed to know about. Next morning at the market, a man working for your master's rival approached you and offered silver for the details.
ev.j_fs_vines.text.E03: The overseer has noticed how deftly you prune vines and graft cuttings. A good vinedresser is valued above everyone on the estate.
ev.j_own_contract.text.E03: The city needs a large order of roof tiles and pipes for the new public baths. The contract will go to a single workshop. The official in charge hints that the matter can be "arranged".
ev.j_ship_pirates.text.E03: News has come: your ship has been seized by pirates off the coast of Cilicia. The cargo has already been sold, and they demand a ransom for the crew.
ev.j_ship_state_later.text.E03: For years of faithful service to the city you've been rewarded: an honorary inscription, exemption from public duties, and a seat in the front rows at festivals.
ev.j_ovs_will.text.E03: After some wine, the master promises that if the estate prospers, he'll free you in his will. It's not the first time he's said so.
ev.j_ovs_will.buy_now.success.E03: The master laughed but took the money. A week later you stood before the magistrate a free person.
